summary: Apex Legends entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Apex Legends

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current high settings/framerate

primary.why: Apex Legends is a live battle royale service. Windows PC has the best settings, framerate, input, and capture ceiling, while console and Switch versions are platform alternates rather than exclusive story routes.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC build through EA app or Steam, record season/date/build context, and capture the specific mode or event being archived.

entries.remaster_caveats: Apex Legends Mobile was a separate discontinued product and is not the primary route for this entry. Record season and event state for any archive capture.
